title: PSI-117 published figure data: experiment vs model series

ReadMe composition for the PROCI_2019 files mixes a mole fraction (XO2 0.1/0.21) with apparent percents (XN2 85/74) under an 'XO3: Balance' header; the PSI seminar (PDF p24) gives XO2 10%, XO3 5%, XN2 balance. Kept as printed.
ReadMe cites 10.1007/s12217-024-10115-x, 10.1016/j.proci.2018.09.015, which are not in the PSI-117 ISA-Tab publication list.

PSI-117 refers to FLEX tests by numbers such as 1268, 1256 and 563; SpaceFire's FLEX table (PSI-69) uses FLEX Test # 1-274 and identifiers such as N01H101. No crosswalk exists, so no PSI-117 series is joined to a FLEX row.

Model series come from a 1-D sphero-symmetric droplet model (slides; dissertation ch. 2). The PSI metadata describes 3-D OpenFOAM work, but no 3-D/CFD output is in the download. Not presented as validated CFD.
